name: call_logs_insert
with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM orbit_profiles_v2 op
  WHERE ((op.id = auth.uid()) AND ((call_logs.caller_orbit_id = op.orbit_id) OR (call_logs.caller_orbit_id = (auth.uid())::text)))))

name: participant_select
qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM conversation_participants_v2 cp
  WHERE ((cp.conversation_id = chat_messages_v2.conversation_id) AND (cp.user_id = auth.uid()))))

name: owner_select
qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM wallet_accounts wa
  WHERE (((wa.id)::text = wallet_ledger_entries.wallet_account_id) AND (wa.owner_user_id = auth.uid()))))
